pages.text:
South gate. Nobody through without a name, and nobody back in after dark
without a better one.

State your business.

options.text: I was sent. I am to be written down.

pages.text:
[She writes, without hurrying, and turns the book around so you can see it.]

There. You exist now, officially, which is more than most things that come out
of that rift manage.

Ennara is open to you. Market north, guild east of the ring road, harbour past
that. Whatever your one told you to go and do -- go and do it. I only keep the
list.

Then you are not going through my gate yet.

Warden is in the middle of the courtyard. Start there, like everybody does.
You are on the list. Go where you like.
